name: Chongqing Genori Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Chongqing Genori Technology Co., Ltd. manufactures core components and materials. Its products include silicon, quartz, silicon carbide, and aluminum oxide ceramic equipment parts used in semiconductor etching and vapor deposition processes. It also provides surface treatments like spray regeneration, anodization, and precision cleaning for vacuum components. The company caters to integrated circuit and display panel manufacturing sectors. The company was founded in 2016 and is based in Chongqing, China.
